title: Beast Academy
text:
Beast Academy is a new project from the math beasts at Art of Problem Solving. Beast Academy will provide a full, rigorous, and entertaining curriculum for aspiring math beasts in grades 1-5.

Beast Academy is set on Beast Island where every person is a monster of some form. The series follows four students named Grogg, Winnie, Alex, and Lizzie Who are taught by Kraken, Professor Grok, Ms. Q, Ms. Levans (in the first grade), and Fiona (in grades 2-5).

Four fully-illustrated Guides per grade provide complete lessons, delivered by the Academy instructors in an engaging comic book style. Companion Practice books include challenging problems, puzzles, and games to reinforce the lessons. Beast Academy is loosely based on the Common Core standards. It covers the key grade-level standards but in greater depth and with more opportunities for problem-solving and logical thinking than other curricula.

Beast Academy Online will also include a variety of digital content. An innovative online learning system will provide a customized learning experience for every child, adjusting to student performance to deliver appropriate problems and lessons.

Guide and Practice books 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 2A, 2B, 2C, 2D, 3A, 3B, 3C, 3D, 4A, 4B, 4C, 4D, 5A, 5B, 5C, and 5D and all puzzle books are available in the bookstore.

Beast Academy has also make stand-alone Puzzle books for some grade levels, inspired by Practice books.

In addition, the new Science series has new books 3A, 3B, and 4A!
